Hi Amy,

Hope you’re well — following up from procurement intake. To move Nova Parts into our vendor roster and enable PO issuance we need a short set of confirmations and supporting docs. Could you please return the items below by EOD Thursday, Apr 15? If anything requires legal review, flag it and we’ll route appropriately.

Required:
- Legal business name exactly as it appears on tax filings
- Tax ID (EIN) or tax classification for payments team
- Registered (legal) address and separate remittance address (if different)
- Invoice delivery method (email address, portal link) and preferred PO contact
- ACH details OR an official bank letter confirming account and routing (we accept a bank letter instead of sharing account numbers over email)
- Completed Redwood vendor onboarding form (attached)
- W-9 (for US entities) or equivalent tax form if non-US

Attachments: Redwood_vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (fillable) — fill inline and return.

Next steps on our side: once we receive these items procurement and payments will create the vendor record and route an initial PO. If you prefer, I can schedule a 15-min sync to walk through the form.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Mateo Alvarez
